mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_history ( request_id, actor_employee_id, action, comment ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{actorEmployeeId}, #{action}, #{comment} )
mapper.select:
SELECT ah.history_id, ah.request_id, ah.actor_employee_id,
e.employee_name AS actor_name, e.department AS actor_department,
ah.action, ah.comment, ah.acted_at
FROM approval_history ah
INNER JOIN employees e ON ah.actor_employee_id = e.employee_id
WHERE ah.request_id = #{requestId}
ORDER BY ah.acted_at ASC, ah.history_id ASC
